limits: Search terms and ranked API results can miss differently named work.
No backward/forward citation search or full-text review was done.
The searched papers establish strong conceptual overlap but do not settle novelty of the exact proposed state/action pairing.
Bibliographic metadata and indexed abstracts were checked; claims about detailed algorithms or experimental quality should be verified in the papers themselves.
conclusion: The current idea is not novel at its broad level: process-aware validation and risk-adaptive test selection already exist. A plausible narrower question is whether transformation lineage plus invariant availability adds information over partition summaries, anomaly scores, and static or adaptive test-selection baselines under equal cost. This remains unverified and is not a novelty claim.
